Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the genealogy by taking Infanta Maria Antónia of Portugal’s mother (Adelaide of Löwenstein-Wertheim-Rosenberg) as Archduchess Elisabeth’s maternal grandmother. This confused the generational level: Zita’s mother (Maria Antónia) is the maternal grandmother, while Adelaide is the great-grandmother.
